items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Clyde Bernhardt, I guess you remember him, trombone player? ... Yes, Clyde played with King Oliver, you know. Because he used to tell me a lot of different things about when he was with King Oliver

ctx.x: Yes, Lee Deere was a -- quite a nightclub operator, he and his brother, Walt Deere, and they was known throughout Kansas, Wichita and little towns where they would have nightclubs and whatnot. They were very good friends of Clyde and Babe Burton. So Lee Deere came to town to pick up the Gray Brothers, which they were all working in a group. Gene Calloway was with that group, Oscar Williams on drums. One Gray brother, Hunter Gray, played alto, Henry playing the trumpet. And he also had Art Bronson, you know, a…
Bronson? How do you spell that?
